mapper.select: SELECT sku.* FROM product_sku sku INNER JOIN product p ON p.id=sku.product_id WHERE p.status=1 AND p.is_deleted=0 AND sku.is_deleted=0 ORDER BY sku.sale_num DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT sku.* FROM product_sku sku INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = sku.product_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND sku.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sku.sale_num DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT p.category3_id AS categoryId, COUNT(*) AS matchCount FROM product p INNER JOIN product_sku sku ON sku.product_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND sku.is_deleted = 0 AND ( p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sku.sku_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) GROUP BY p.category3_id ORDER BY matchCount DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT sku.id, sku.sku_code, sku.sku_name, sku.product_id, sku.thumb_img, sku.sale_price, sku.market_price, sku.stock_num, sku.sale_num, p.name AS productName, b.name AS brandName, p.category1_id AS category1Id, p.category2_id AS category2Id, p.category3_id AS category3Id, p.brand_id AS brandId FROM product_sku sku LEFT JOIN product p ON sku.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN brand b ON p.brand_id = b.id WHERE sku.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.audit_status = 1
